versions.content: Initialize Ethernet controller with MACsec support, where MACsec functionality is enabled At initialization of an Ethernet controller, the Eth driver shall initialize each Ether- net controller with the corresponding EthCtrlConfig configuration where EthCtrl- MacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE , and consider the following configuration parameter if available: • initialize the Ethernet controller with all configured EthCtrlMacSecBypas- sEtherType s to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames carrying the configured EtherType • initialize the Ethernet controller with all configured EthCtrlMacSecBy- passVlan s to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames carrying the con- figured VLAN-ID • initialize the Ethernet controller with all configured EthCtrlMacSecBypass- DestinationMacAddress es to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames carrying the configured destination MAC address
